name: Warhammer: The Game of Fantasy Battles - 9th Edition v2.32

shootingToHit.description: Ballistic Skill determines the score needed to hit when shooting. Roll 1D6 per shot.
notes: A natural 1 always misses.
If required score is 7+, roll a 6 first, then re-roll needing the remainder (7+=6 then 4+, 8+=6 then 5+, 9+=6 then 6+, 10+ impossible).
Soft and hard cover do not stack - use the best cover available.

closeCombatToHit.description: Compare attacker's Weapon Skill vs target's Weapon Skill. Roll 1D6 per Attack.
notes: A natural 6 always hits, a natural 1 always misses.
Equal WS = 4+ to hit.
Attacker WS > Target WS = 3+ to hit.
Attacker WS > 2x Target WS = 2+ to hit.
Target WS > 2x Attacker WS = 5+ to hit.
Target WS > 2x Attacker WS + 3 = 6+ to hit.

toWound.description: Compare Strength of attack vs Toughness of target. Same table used for both shooting and close combat.
notes: A natural 6 always wounds, a natural 1 always fails.
S = T: 4+ to wound.
S = T+1: 3+ to wound.
S >= T+2: 2+ to wound.
S = T-1: 5+ to wound.
S <= T-2: 6+ to wound.

armourSaves.description: After a wound is caused, the target may attempt an armour save. Saves are modified by the Strength of the attack.
notes: Armour saves are cumulative from different equipment pieces.
A save can never be better than 1+.
A natural roll of 1 always fails the save.
Strength 4+ attacks apply negative modifiers to armour saves.

wardSaves.description: A special save that is never modified by Strength. Taken after armour save fails (or if no armour save).
notes: Ward saves are never modified by Strength of the attack.
Multiple Ward saves can be combined, but no model may have better than 4+ Ward save from combining.
A single Ward save source CAN be 2+ or 3+ without the 4+ cap.
Ward save is taken after armour save fails.
A natural roll of 1 always fails.

combatResult.description: After all attacks in close combat, calculate combat result to determine winner.

bonuses.charge: +1 if the unit charged this turn
bonuses.extraRanks: +1 per extra complete rank beyond the first (max +3)
bonuses.outnumber: +1 if higher Unit Strength than all engaged enemies

breakTest.description: The loser of combat must take a Break test. Roll 2D6 against modified Leadership.
notes: Modified Leadership = Leadership - (enemy combat result - your combat result).
If modified Leadership is 0 or below, the test automatically fails.
If test is failed, the unit breaks and flees.
Steadfast: Units with more complete ranks than all individual enemy units take Break test on unmodified Leadership.
Stubborn: Always use unmodified Leadership for Break tests.
Unbreakable: Never takes Break tests.

fleeing.description: Fleeing and pursuing units move 2D6 inches. If pursuit >= flee distance, fleeing unit is destroyed.
notes: If pursuit roll >= flee roll, fleeing unit takes 2 wounds per Unit Strength of pursuers (no saves).
Victorious unit may choose to pursue or restrain (restraining requires a Leadership test).
Pursuing units can charge enemy units in their path.

panic.description: Certain events force units to take a Panic test (Leadership test). If failed, the unit flees.
triggers: Heavy Casualties: Unit loses 25% or more of its Unit Strength in a single phase.
Nearby Friend Annihilated: Friendly unit with US 10+ is destroyed within 6 inches.
Nearby Friend Breaks: Friendly unit with US 10+ breaks from combat within 6 inches.
Fled Through: Fleeing unit with US 10+ moves through the unit.
exceptions: Units in close combat do not take Panic tests.
Already fleeing units do not take Panic tests.
Units that already passed a Panic test this phase do not take another.

regeneration.description: Works like a Ward save, but cannot be used against Flaming Attacks.
notes: Regeneration saves can be combined with Ward saves.

magicResistance.description: Adds bonus to dispel attempts and Ward saves against magical attacks.
notes: Magic Resistance (X) grants a X+ Ward save against wounds caused by spells.

commonSpecialRules.alwaysStrikesFirst: Model strikes at Initiative 10 in close combat. If both sides have ASF, cancel out and use normal Initiative.
commonSpecialRules.alwaysStrikesLast: Model strikes at Initiative 1 in close combat. If both sides have ASL, cancel out and use normal Initiative.
commonSpecialRules.armourPiercing: Armour Piercing (X): The attack has an additional -X modifier to armour saves.
commonSpecialRules.flaming: Flaming Attacks: Wounds caused count as Flaming. Negates Regeneration saves.
commonSpecialRules.hatred: Re-roll missed To Hit rolls in the first round of close combat.
commonSpecialRules.killingBlow: A natural To Wound roll of 6 kills the target outright (no armour save allowed, Ward saves still apply). Only affects Infantry, War Beasts and Swarms.
commonSpecialRules.heroicKillingBlow: As Killing Blow, but works against all troop types.
commonSpecialRules.multipleWounds: Multiple Wounds (X): Each unsaved wound is multiplied into X wounds.
commonSpecialRules.poisonedAttacks: A natural To Hit roll of 6 automatically wounds (no To Wound roll needed).
commonSpecialRules.stubbornness: Always uses unmodified Leadership for Break tests.
commonSpecialRules.unbreakable: Automatically passes all Break tests. Cannot flee.
commonSpecialRules.frenzy: +1 Attack. Must pursue and overrun. Must charge if able. Loses Frenzy if broken in combat.
commonSpecialRules.fear: Units in base contact with Fear-causing enemy must pass a Leadership test or hit on 6s only. Fear-causing units do not take Panic from Fear-causing enemies.
commonSpecialRules.terror: Causes Fear. Additionally, enemy units must pass a Leadership test when charged or within 6 inches, or flee.
commonSpecialRules.impactHits: Impact Hits (X): Inflicts X automatic hits at the model's Strength when charging.
commonSpecialRules.fightInExtraRank: Models in one additional rank may fight in close combat (e.g., spears).
commonSpecialRules.requiresTwoHands: Cannot use a shield in close combat.
commonSpecialRules.parry: Models with hand weapon and shield gain a 6+ Ward save in close combat (not against Strength 2x or more their own).

handWeapon.name: Hand Weapon
handWeapon.notes: If armed with another close combat weapon, must use that instead.

spear.name: Spear
specialRules: Mighty Blow (1) when charged to front
spear.notes: Model on foot only. +1 Initiative only when charged to front. Mighty Blow does not apply to Infantry, Large Infantry, Swarms and Shrines.

pike.name: Pike
specialRules: Mighty Blow (1) when charged to front
pike.notes: Model on foot only. +1 Initiative bonus when charged to front. Mighty Blow does not apply to Infantry, Large Infantry, Swarms and Shrines.

lightLance.name: Light Lance
lightLance.notes: Mounted model only. Bonuses only on the turn the model charges.

heavyLance.name: Heavy Lance
heavyLance.notes: Mounted model only. Bonuses only on the turn the model charges.

pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.notes: In close combat counts as additional hand weapon (no Parry).

blunderbuss.name: Blunderbuss
blunderbuss.notes: No penalty for Stand and Shoot.

shield.name: Shield
shield.notes: Models on foot get +1 extra vs missile attacks to the front.
